title: Sneezing
cue: What the one who sneezes says, the reply, and the answer to it

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 6224: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/9316

variants.label: The one who hears says: "May Allah have mercy on you."
The one who sneezed answers: "May Allah guide you and set your affairs right."
